title: A Warm Evening
setting: A park at sunset with a bench and a path.

characters.name: Kofi
characters.look: Kofi, a young boy with short black hair and a blue shirt

characters.name: Max
characters.look: Max, his younger brother with glasses and a green sweater

sentences.en: Kofi and his brother Max sit in the park.
sentences.zh: 科菲和弟弟马克斯坐在公园里。
sentences.scene_prompt: Kofi, a young boy with short black hair and a blue shirt and Max, his younger brother with glasses and a green sweater sit on a park bench at sunset.

sentences.en: The evening air is warm because the sun shines.
sentences.zh: 因为阳光照耀，傍晚的空气很温暖。
sentences.scene_prompt: Kofi, a young boy with short black hair and a blue shirt and Max, his younger brother with glasses and a green sweater enjoy the warm evening on the bench, a low orange sun shining over the park.

sentences.en: Max's homework is very difficult today.
sentences.zh: 马克斯今天的作业很难。
sentences.scene_prompt: Max, his younger brother with glasses and a green sweater frowns at a notebook on his lap, scratching his head.

sentences.en: Kofi checks everything and finds the right answers.
sentences.zh: 科菲检查了所有题目，找出了正确答案。
sentences.scene_prompt: Kofi, a young boy with short black hair and a blue shirt looks over the notebook of Max, his younger brother with glasses and a green sweater and points to the answers with a pencil.

sentences.en: Max's lunch bag includes two red apples.
sentences.zh: 马克斯的午餐袋里有两个红苹果。
sentences.scene_prompt: Max, his younger brother with glasses and a green sweater opens a small lunch bag with two red apples inside.

sentences.en: Max eats one apple, and Kofi eats the other.
sentences.zh: 马克斯吃了一个苹果，科菲吃了另一个。
sentences.scene_prompt: Max, his younger brother with glasses and a green sweater and Kofi, a young boy with short black hair and a blue shirt each bite into a red apple on the bench.

sentences.en: Somebody on a horse comes into the park.
sentences.zh: 有人骑着马走进了公园。
sentences.scene_prompt: A rider on a brown horse passes along the park path in front of Kofi, a young boy with short black hair and a blue shirt and Max, his younger brother with glasses and a green sweater on the bench.

sentences.en: The horse is much taller than Max.
sentences.zh: 那匹马比马克斯高得多。
sentences.scene_prompt: Max, his younger brother with glasses and a green sweater stands next to the brown horse, looking up at it, much shorter than the horse.
